{"id":1797101777,"question_id":4019,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months, 1 week","timestamp":1760080006,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"91 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1797101777/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Remove K-Balanced Substrings","memory":"42.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n\n    void helper(stack<pair<char, int>>& st, int &k){\n        if(st.top().first == ')' && st.top().second == k){\n            // top nikalo -> temp\n            auto temp = st.top();\n            st.pop();\n            // ab new top wala chek karo \n            if(!st.empty() && st.top().first == '(' && st.top().second >= k){\n                st.top().second -= k;\n                if(st.top().second == 0){\n                    st.pop();\n                }\n            }\n            else{\n                st.push(temp);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    string removeSubstring(string s, int k) {\n        stack<pair<char, int>> st;\n\n        for(int i = 0; i<s.length(); i++){\n\n            if(!st.empty() && st.top().first == s[i]){\n                st.top().second++;\n                helper(st, k);\n            }\n            else{\n                st.push({s[i], 1});\n                if(k == 1){\n                    helper(st, k);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        string ans = \"\";\n        while(!st.empty()){\n            int count = st.top().second;\n            char ch = st.top().first;\n            while(count--){\n                ans.push_back(ch);\n            }\n            st.pop();\n        }\n        reverse(ans.begin(), ans.end());\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"remove-k-balanced-substrings","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":912}
